subject: Marketplace private-offer: PPU slabing & accelerator ask
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria@cloudscale.com>, procurement@cloudscale.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace private-offer: PPU slabing & accelerator ask

Hi Maria — great to connect earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the two asks we agreed to: 

1) Confirm monthly token volumes (avg + peak) and expected seasonality so we can map to marketplace SKU slabs. You mentioned 50M–120M tokens/mo initially with a 3x peak during campaign months — can you confirm which quarters you expect spikes?

2) Budget and target unit economics: you said procurement is working toward a target of approximately $900–1,200 per 1M tokens on marketplace private offers (including marketplace fees). If that target is flexible, tell us the absolute must-have and stretch numbers.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Maria / CloudScale: send Q1 usage export and any forecast assumptions (attachment would be ideal) — by EOD Monday 4/13.
- Jonas: produce a private-offer mapping (SKU slab -> PPU equivalent) and two pricing scenarios (conservative & accelerated) for AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace — deliver by Wed 4/15.
- Karhtik: suggest any internal concessional accelerators (e.g., first-90-day credits, onboarding credits) that we can attach to a private offer — quick note by Tue 4/14.

I attached a simple CSV template for the usage export and the PO template we usually hand to procurement. Also attaching an internal draft mapping (very rough) so Maria can see the format I'll use.

Thanks again — appreciate Maria walking us through CloudScale's campaign cadence. If procurement prefers a direct pricing workshop, we can set 30 minutes next week.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: usage_report_Q1.csv (stub), private-offer-draft.docx (stub), PO_Template.pdf (stub)

From: Maria Lopez <maria@cloudscale.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudscale.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace private-offer: PPU slabing & accelerator ask

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the template. Quick answers inline:

- Volumes: our current steady-state is ~60M tokens/mo (mostly inference for chat + summarization). We have three planned marketing pushes in Q3 that could push us to ~200M tokens/mo for 6–8 weeks each. We expect Q3 spikes but Q1–Q2 are fairly steady.

- Budget: procurement is targeting $1,000 / 1M tokens as the preferred net target on marketplace private offers (that is post-marketplace fee). The absolute max they will sign for without further exec approval is $1,400 / 1M. Stretch if we can combine onboarding credits + a 6-month volume commitment could be $850 / 1M.

I'm attaching our Q1 export (filled the template). Let me know if you need per-model breakdowns — we can provide that tomorrow.

—Maria
Maria Lopez
Head of Product, CloudScale Inc.
maria@cloudscale.com

Attachments: usage_report_Q1.csv (filled)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria@cloudscale.com>, procurement@cloudscale.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace private-offer: PPU slabing & accelerator ask

Thanks Maria — received the CSV, looks good and very helpful. A couple clarifying Qs before we build the two scenarios: 

- For the $1,000 / 1M target (post-marketplace fee) — is that intended to be applicable during steady-state only, or inclusive of campaign months? If it must hold during spikes we will likely need a tiered slab (lower PPU at higher monthly commitments).

- You mentioned the stretch $850 / 1M with onboarding credits + 6-month volume commit. Can you indicate whether CloudScale is comfortable with a 6-month minimum commitment or prefers a quarterly review cadence? This affects how aggressive we can be with the private-offer unit price.

Ben and Karhtik — tagging you both for quick input on acceptable accelerator structures for this tier and any marketplace-specific constraints you've seen (AWS private offer minimums, GCP negotiated discounts, etc.).

I will draft: (A) conservative mapping: matches $1,000/1M at steady-state with campaign-tier discounts and (B) accelerated mapping: targets $850/1M effective with a 6-month commit + onboarding credit of $25k spread across first two months. Expect the draft by end of day Wed.

Jonas

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria@cloudscale.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace private-offer: PPU slabing & accelerator ask

Quick notes from pricing ops: 

- AWS private offers: typical activations allow us to set per-unit pricing across SKU slabs; marketplace takes ~8–12% depending on program. We need to net to CloudScale's target after marketplace fees.
- For $850 / 1M net target we can design a 3-slab structure: 0–75M, 75–250M, 250M+ with aggressive step-downs. Combine that with a $25k onboarding credit applied as bill-credit over first 2 invoice cycles to hit the effective rate.
- GCP marketplace generally requires committed spend windows; we can mirror the slabing but may need a minimum 3-month commit.

Ben — if you can confirm whether we want to include a short-term pilot discount (one-month free or 50% first-month) vs onboarding credit, that will change the optics for procurement at CloudScale.

I'll sync with Jonas on the private-offer draft and convert the slab math into $/1M tokens post-fee.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: none
